canada.title: Military recovers unexploded shell along banks of St. Lawrence River
canada.summary: The shell was discovered by residents using a metal detector. Two shells were found in the same area last July. Department of National Defence is leading an effort to collect projectiles from the nearby Lac Saint-Pierre.

canada.title: Missing boaters from Nain found safe by search and rescue team
canada.summary: The RCMP says 62-year-old Julius Lampe and 51-year-old Ephriam Merkuratsuk have been located and are confirmed safe, following a tense weekend after the men were reported overdue during a boating trip from Nain to Natuashish.
